title: Magentic-One: A Generalist Multi-Agent System for Solving Complex Tasks

live_model.evidence: "the default multimodal LLM we use for all agents (except the ComputerTerminal) is gpt-4o-2024-05-13"; "only the GPT-4o variant was evaluated [on WebArena]", test-set result 30.5% (119 of 390).

prompt.location: Sec 5.1 (WebArena Postmill-clarification prompt text quoted verbatim); Appendix A/B/C (statistical methodology, capability mapping, code definitions)
prompt.note: One example prompt insert is quoted in full; complete per-agent system prompts are in the publicly released code (aka.ms/magentic-one), not fully reprinted in the paper body.

claim.metric: WebArena task completion rate (self-imposed held-out test split, GPT-4o-only configuration)
claim.location: Sec 5.2 ("falling to 30.5% (119 of 390) for the test set"); Table 1 (WebArena, all 812 tasks reported for the full validation+test pool)

data.source: WebArena, GAIA, AssistantBench (public agent benchmarks); Magentic-One code public at https://aka.ms/magentic-one

notes: GAIA and AssistantBench results use a GPT-4o + o1-preview combination (o1-preview is a dead preview, not on the still-callable list), so the WebArena-only, GPT-4o-only result is the cleanest isolated claim for gpt-4o-2024-05-13. Multi-agent web-browsing tasks with screenshots imply many LLM calls per task (est_calls not confidently estimated); high cost tier from agent-loop length and multimodal input alone.
